newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Inkombank says it plans dollar Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Inkombank says it plans dollar Eurobond.

text.p: AB Inkombank, one of Russia's biggest banks, said on Thursday it would issue a dollar Eurobond running for up to five years when the bulk of its current Euro commercial paper programme has been placed.

"Inkombank plans, after it has placed most of its Euro commercial paper, to issue either medium-term notes or Eurobonds, depending on our feeling for the market. In any case the next paper will not run for more than five years," Vice-President Rafael Nagapetyants told a news conference.
Last month Inkombank Finance BV established a $200 million Euro-CP programme. By mid-June Inkombank plans to place up to one quarter of the issue, Nagapetyants said.
Nagapetyants said the bank would soon publish a credit rating from rating agency IBCA, and possibly from Standard & Poor's and Moody's.
Inkombank had previously said it would issue a two-three year Eurobond in mid-1997.
